title: Protected append-ledger head anchor
x-semantic-rules: anchor_sha256 hashes RFC 8785 canonical bytes excluding only anchor_sha256. anchor_generation increments exactly one and previous_anchor_sha256 equals the prior protected anchor for non-genesis updates.
The validator reads the protected anchor itself using anchor_path_id and frozen root policy. A caller-supplied naked expected head is never authoritative.

The ledger append is durable and hash-verified before anchor replacement. A crash before replacement leaves at most one recoverable, fully verified unanchored tail; a crash after replacement must reveal the new exact file identity, sequence and head.

Stale, ahead, behind, rewritten, ACL-drifted, reparse-linked or wrong-release anchors fail closed. A self-consistent rewritten ledger plus a caller-provided rewritten head still fails against this anchor chain.
Two writers must contend on the same protected exclusive lease and anchor generation CAS; no lost update or split-brain anchor is permitted.
